profile.name: Odin探测器采集系统
profile.description: 用于实验中高速探测器数据读出与写入的采集系统，负责接收探测器输出并将连续帧写入数据流或文件，常见于同步辐射、成像和其他高通量测量场景。
profile.description_en: A data acquisition and writing system for high-speed detectors, used to receive detector output and write sequential frames to data streams or files. It is commonly used in synchrotron, imaging, and other high-throughput measurement setups.

registry.name: Diamond Light Source Writing
registry.description: Odin是由Diamond Light Source生产的后处理设备，主要功能包括关闭、打开。支持Signal, Slot, collect stream docs等操作。
